name: planned-node-removal-reflected
body: Adding or removing a planned code FQN (`apg plan add <project> planned …` / `apg plan rm planned …`) updates `db.lbug` immediately. The re-ingest path must not assume every transient node carries a `<project>/` FQN prefix: deletion targets the exact FQN(s) the mutation touched (the named planned node and its cascade), not a prefix scan. Acceptance: removing a planned code FQN that has no `<project>/` prefix (e.g. `apg.session.start`) leaves no stale row — `apg_query` for that FQN returns nothing immediately, with the code graph otherwise untouched.
